_semantics.IMPLEMENTED_LOCAL_VERIFIED: State machine / provenance enforced in code with local test evidence; ACTIVE requires the Acceptance Gate (green remote CI on a PR + SSoT consistency validator) to pass.
_semantics.HARDENED: v2.8.2 governance-enforcement hotfix: actor-policy transition gate (P0-1), claim-provenance input validation + same-transaction atomicity (P0-2/P0-3), append-only audit-trail triggers (P1-1), and reviewer-assignment hygiene on requeue (P1-2) are enforced in code with local test evidence. Does NOT cover Quality-Plane semantic fail-open behavior (judge default-pass on missing data, the 0.85 confidence threshold, unfiltered Axis_6 lineage traversal) — those are explicitly deferred to v2.9.0.
_semantics.ci_evidence_placeholders: run_id=0, tested_head_sha=the null SHA, conclusion=PENDING_VERIFICATION, and verified_at=null are DELIBERATE PLACEHOLDERS pending a real governance-ci run against the actual merge commit. The owner (or a CI step) MUST overwrite all four fields with the real GitHub Actions run_id, head SHA, conclusion, and verification timestamp at merge time. A conclusion of 'success' must never be pre-filled before that run has actually been observed — doing so is the exact CI self-attestation failure this field exists to prevent.
_semantics.authority: This file is the single source of truth for dynamic project state; MANIFEST.json must reference, never duplicate, it.
